name: Low Stock Alert for WooCommerce
author: Tarikul Islam

sections.description:
Low Stock Alert for WooCommerce helps you manage your store inventory by sending automatic email alerts to the admin whenever a product’s stock goes below a defined threshold.

Forget about manually checking your product stock levels — this plugin keeps track for you and notifies you in real time so you can take action fast.

🛍️ Key Features

  • ✅ Automatic email notifications when stock is low
  • 🛠️ Customizable alert quantity (global setting)
  • 📬 Clean, informative email template
  • 📄 Log page showing the last 10 stock alert emails

⚙️ How It Works

  1. The plugin monitors all WooCommerce products for stock changes.
  2. If stock falls below the alert quantity, an email is sent to the admin.
  3. Admins can configure the alert threshold from the plugin settings page.
  4. A log page shows the 10 most recent alert emails sent.

Credits

Developed with ❤️ by tarikulalways

License

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/wc-low-stock-alert directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugin screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Low Stock Alert Settings to configure your preferred alert quantity and admin email.
sections.faq:
Can I set a different alert threshold for individual products?

Not yet. Currently, the plugin uses a global threshold value. Per-product alert thresholds will be added in a future update.

Does this plugin work with variable products?

Yes, it fully supports both simple and variable products.

Can I send alerts to more than one email address?

At the moment, only one email address is supported. Multiple recipients support is coming soon.
